OhGeesy is a Los Angeles rapper who became widely known as a founding member of Shoreline Mafia. The group broke through with records including “Musty,” “Nun Major” and “Bottle Service,” eventually signing with Atlantic Records in 2018. 

OhGeesy later established a successful solo career, releasing his debut solo project GEEZYWORLD in 2021 and working with artists including YG, DaBaby and Central Cee. He and Fenix Flexin eventually reunited as Shoreline Mafia, releasing new music beginning with “Heat Stick” in 2024 and continuing with new projects in 2025 and 2026. 

Fenix Flexin, born Fenix Rypinski, is a Los Angeles rapper best known as a founding member of Shoreline Mafia. He met OhGeesy while they were teenagers in Los Angeles, and the two started making music together before forming Shoreline Mafia The group broke out in the late 2010s with songs like “Musty,” “Nun Major,” “Bottle Service,” and “Bands,” becoming an important part of the modern West Coast rap scene. 

In 2026, Fenix also gained major solo attention with “RUBBERZ,” a dramatic switch from his traditional West Coast rap sound that became one of his biggest solo records.
